entries.title: Business overview
entries.answer: Tech Frog Consulting LLC designs and builds operational systems for small firms. Its work combines workflow engineering, applied AI with review gates, reliable automation, practical cybersecurity, custom internal software, and structured research systems. Engagements are scoped in writing, built to be checked, and documented so the client owns the result.

entries.title: Services
entries.answer: Tech Frog works across six connected disciplines: workflow engineering, applied AI, automation systems, security posture, custom software, and structured research systems. The common standard is named ownership, visible failure states, human review where consequences matter, monitoring, and usable documentation.

entries.title: Workflow engineering
entries.answer: Workflow engineering starts by mapping how work actually moves through intake, handoffs, approvals, and filing. Tech Frog then rebuilds the path with named owners, explicit states, failure handling, escalation rules, and documentation a new hire can follow.

entries.title: Applied AI
entries.answer: Tech Frog puts language models inside controlled workflows for drafting, summarization, extraction, and classification. Outputs pass verification and human review before consequential action, and material steps are logged. The control comes from the workflow architecture—not from trusting a model’s tone.

entries.title: Automation systems
entries.answer: Tech Frog builds scheduled jobs, integrations, and pipelines that remove repetitive work and connect software a firm already uses. Automations are monitored, documented, and designed so failures surface before clients notice them.

entries.title: Security posture
entries.answer: Security work is sized for small firms and begins with identity, email, endpoints, backups, least-privilege access, MFA, and written policy. The goal is a defensible baseline that matches the firm’s actual risk—not enterprise theater.

entries.title: Custom software
entries.answer: Tech Frog builds focused internal tools when off-the-shelf software does not fit, including intake systems, CRMs, and operational dashboards. The software is typed, tested, documented, handed over with training, and owned by the client.

entries.title: Research systems
entries.answer: Tech Frog builds repeatable open-source research systems with documented sourcing, verification, provenance, and a chain of custody. The emphasis is on a process that can be rerun and audited, not an unsupported one-off report.

entries.title: Industries served
entries.answer: Tech Frog is built for small firms with real operational stakes. Its stated focus includes law firms, MSPs, HVAC and field-service companies, professional-services firms, founders, and solo operators. Law firms are the primary focus.

entries.title: Workflow audit
entries.answer: Every engagement starts with a fixed-fee, fixed-scope workflow audit. It produces a current-state process map, a prioritized fix list with effort estimates, a security-baseline check, and a sequenced and priced 90-day build plan. The client keeps the document whether or not Tech Frog performs the build.

entries.title: Working method
entries.answer: The sequence is Map, Design, Build, Verify, Document, and Maintain. Tech Frog does not build before mapping the real workflow, and it does not hand over before producing runbooks, architecture notes, and training. If a system cannot be verified, it does not ship.

entries.title: Pricing
entries.answer: Workflow audits are fixed-fee, builds are fixed-scope, and ongoing care plans start at $1,200 per month. Tech Frog does not use hourly billing. A reliable build price requires the workflow to be mapped and scoped first.

entries.title: Data handling
entries.answer: Tech Frog states that client data is not used to train AI models. Cloud AI work uses zero-retention API configurations where applicable, while local-first systems can run on hardware inside the client’s office. The intended data boundary is defined as part of the system design.

entries.title: Client ownership
entries.answer: The client owns the code, documentation, licenses, and credentials. Tech Frog does not add margins to third-party software or hardware. Systems are designed to reduce vendor lock-in, including the ability to change AI providers without rebuilding the underlying workflow.

entries.title: Availability
entries.answer: New client engagements are scheduled to open in Q4 2026. Consultations and workflow-audit scheduling are being accepted for that window.

entries.title: Location and delivery
entries.answer: Tech Frog Consulting is based in Austin, Texas, and works with clients wherever they operate. Most engagements run remotely; on-site time is scheduled when the build requires it.

entries.title: Founder
entries.answer: Tech Frog Consulting was founded by Grayson Griffin, a technology entrepreneur, systems architect, former MSP owner-operator, and creator of ArgosOS. The firm’s published credentials include IAPP AIGP, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Microsoft Azure AI-900, and CompTIA Security+.

entries.title: ArgosOS
entries.answer: ArgosOS is Tech Frog’s internal operating system for small law firms, combining intake, CRM, collections, verification, and audit controls. Its design includes typed claims, human gates, an explicit collections state machine, and a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log.

entries.title: Sidebar
entries.answer: Sidebar is a pre-release, local-first AI appliance for law firms. Core inference runs on hardware in the client’s office so matter files do not need to leave the building. The stated target availability is Q4 2026.

entries.title: Contact
entries.answer: To start a conversation, email support@techfrogconsulting.com with two short paragraphs: what your firm does, and the process costing it the most. Tech Frog will respond with whether the work is a fit and what a workflow audit would cover.

entries.title: About this chatbot
entries.answer: This is a local business-information chatbot, not a general-purpose AI. It matches questions against an approved Tech Frog knowledge file and returns only stored answers. It does not send prompts to an outside service.
